author: SickProdigy
description: An experimental global Pokémon collection with opt-in activity spawns, persistent wild battles, and catching.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, globally owned Pokémon, party selections, inventory counts, catch provenance, active battles, and guild/channel spawn configuration. User deletion removes the requesting user's collection and active encounters.
install_msg: Configure an opt-in channel with `[p]pokemon set channel #channel`, then choose a starter with `[p]pokemon starter bulbasaur`. This is an unofficial noncommercial prototype.
name: Pokemon
short: Global Pokémon catching and wild battles
